title: New novel ‘Sunlight Finds You’ explores how a first love can affect one’s entire life
summary_en: In a new novel, Laura Moriarty, a professor of English at the University of Kansas, crafts a coming-of-age tale set in 1950s Florida. It has been selected as a featured book for “The Today Show.” Moriarty will give talks at several events across Kansas this month.
